Desperate times need desperate solutions. Every legendary Elven warrior spirit was doomed to dwell inside cold colossal statues. The damnation to continue war against uncivilized aliens once again.

FEATURES:
- separate torsos and legs;
- 5 separate heavy weapon back vanes.

UPDATE:
2024 May 14th - separate legs for Macrowraith models added, models are upscaled.

NOTICE:
- the models are not tested yet, there’re no supported stls required for safe printing, so the prints are required for experienced hobbyists;
- model sturdiness is questionable (the hip is 1.2mm thick);
- the preview image is dated.

THANKS TO:
- PopsicleBallista for original models ( https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/grim_humptydumpty_robot );
- Lord_Chronos for permission to use his works for free sharing ( https://cults3d.com/en/users/Lord_Chronos/3d-models )

Epic scale Evil Marines Tomb Walker. A simple remix of some bodies I found on Thingiverse so that they fit onto the legs for Miffles_Makes Tomb Walker.
Also included some rescaled weapons for added variety.

The glaive/scythe arm is super thin so be careful.

There are a lot of bits mixed into this so I will try credit all the sources. I am sure I will miss something, it has been a long time since I put these together.

Miffles_Makes for the Tomb walker parts
https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:2866258

https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3905651

onebitpixel for the autocannons
